reports.headline: The Last Flash
reports.body: The largest crater yet lies {dir} of the village {dist}, and at its centre something still stands upright: a black shard that hums when touched. {name} says it is the point everything struck, and that it is still waiting for more.

reports.headline: Something Waits at the Impact Point
reports.body: {name} says a black shard stands at the bottom of the newest crater {dir} of here {dist}, still warm, still humming. The craters have stopped, the elders say, because it has finally found a place to wait.
